title: The Steamvault
body: The Steamvault is the working heart of Coilfang Reservoir, a warren of flooded halls beneath Serpent Lake where the naga keep great machinery running. Inside, the air hangs thick and hot with steam, and the thrum of the great pumps never stops. Coilfang engineers, sorceresses, sirens, oracles, myrmidons and warriors hold its passages, and slavemasters drive gangs of Dreghood Broken at the work, calling on their slaves to fight for them when intruders come. Leper gnomes lurk among the machines, bog overlords stalk the shallows, and elementals of steam and tide rise from the water. Lesser masters hold the outer halls, and beyond them a great door seals the main chambers, where Warlord Kalithresh commands the vault among his naga distillers.
sources: zones/steamvault.txt (map 545: area 3715 only)

title: Hydromancer Thespia
body: Hydromancer Thespia is a naga sorceress of the Steamvault, a siren of the Coilfang who commands water and storm, and elementals of water stand with her in her hall. She meets intruders with threats that the depths will consume them, or that they will drown in blood, and she fights with the weather itself: she calls clouds of lightning down on her foes, bidding the warm bloods enjoy the storm, and wraps them in buffeting winds and sudden bursts of crushing pressure.

parts.body: Thespia fell in her hall, and the water elementals that had served her vanished with her. With her last breath she promised her killers that their matron would be the end of them, and she did not say who that matron was.

title: Mekgineer Steamrigger
body: Mekgineer Steamrigger is a towering machine of iron and steam that tramps through its corner of the Steamvault, bellowing threats: a world of hurt, hot metal, or that it will come over there. Its arsenal is a tinker's nightmare of whirling saw blades, an electrified net and a ray that shrinks its foes to a fraction of their size. It does not fight alone for long. Leper gnome mechanics hurry to it in the middle of a fight to patch and repair it, and their master crows that it is bringing the pain.

parts.body: For all its saws and nets and the mechanics who swarmed to mend it, the great machine came down at last. The voice that had promised hot metal and a world of hurt cried out a single word as it failed: Mommy.

title: Warlord Kalithresh
body: Warlord Kalithresh commands the Steamvault from its main chambers, a naga war leader who stands among the great distillers of the vault, his warriors and sorceresses about him. He expects to be challenged. Those who reach him hear him scoff that they deem themselves worthy simply because they bested his guards, and swear that the work here will not be compromised. In the fight he wields a trident, impaling his foes, turning their spells back on them and cracking their skulls, and he despises surface dwellers and all their kind.

parts.body: The Cenarion Expedition knows his name too. Hiding very, very quietly at the entrance to the reservoir, Watcher Jhang saw a band of naga go through the archway of the second tunnel from the left, and the one word she clearly understood was Kalithresh. She is too weak to help, but she wants him found and stopped.
sources: quest 9763 description (hiding very, very quietly at the entrance; a group of naga through the stone archway on the second tunnel from the left; one word: Kalithresh; the entrance to the steam vaults, where Warlord Kalithresh has been commanding his troops from; I am too weak)

parts.body: Kalithresh fought beside his distillers, drawing on them to feed a warlord's rage and swearing that this was not nearly over. It was. He died crying out for her Excellency, for Vashj, and the distillers about him died with him.
sources: creature_text 17798 groups 1 (This is not nearly over...), 4 (For her Excellency... for... Vashj!) and 5 (begins to channel from the nearby distiller)
boss_warlord_kalithresh.cpp (every 45 seconds a Naga Distiller 17954 casts Warlord's Rage on him with SAY_REGEN and the emote; JustDied: SAY_DEATH, the distillers KillSelf)

parts.body: Jhang called him the Expedition's biggest enemy in the region, dead at last. Whoever had slain him had done the Expedition a great favor, she said, and the druids would be forever in their debt.
sources: quest 9763 reward text (Our biggest enemy in the region is finally dead. You've done the expedition a great favor; forever in your debt)

parts.body: In Shattrath, A'dal makes the warlord's death one half of the trial of strength. Those who would prove themselves to the naaru must destroy the leader of the Coilfang Steamvaults and bring his trident to the Terrace of Light, along with the other proof the trial demands.
sources: quest 10885 description (The trial of strength is divided in two. You must destroy the leader of the Coilfang Steamvaults, Warlord Kalithresh, and bring me his trident.)

parts.body: Kalithresh's trident was carried to A'dal on the Terrace of Light together with the other proof the trial demanded, and the naaru greeted its bearer and spoke: well done. The trial of strength was passed.

title: Orders from Lady Vashj
body: The naga of the Steamvault carry their orders with them, and one letter taken from them is worth more than all the rest. It holds detailed orders for the Coilfang naga who run the steam vaults. It warns of the arrival of Cenarion druids in the region and commands that they be slain on sight, and it orders the rate at which water is redirected from the other lakes into Coilfang Reservoir to be doubled. It bears the seal of the infamous Lady Vashj. The druids of the Cenarion Expedition will want to see it, above all their leader, Ysiel Windsinger, at the Cenarion Refuge.

parts.body: Vashj, Ysiel breathed. This was much more than the druids had bargained for. If Lady Vashj was involved, then the Expedition's small victories against the naga here and there meant nothing, for forces much greater than her own were at work. Now, she said, they must prepare for war.
sources: quest 9764 reward text (Vashj! This is much more than we bargained for. Our small victories here and there against the naga mean nothing. If Lady Vashj is involved in this, then forces much greater than us are at work. ... Now, we must prepare for war.)

parts.body: The Cenarion Expedition began as a peaceful venture, but it now faces the prospect of all out war with the naga. Many among the druids are willing to fight but ill equipped, so Ysiel asks for the naga's own weapons, the best armaments of the Coilfang, to be reforged into glaives and arrowheads.
sources: quest 9765 description (began as a peaceful venture; all out war with the naga; willing to fight but are ill equipped; reforge them into glaives and arrowheads; only the best armaments)

parts.body: The armaments would do perfectly, Ysiel said, and she asked for any more that could be found. The Expedition's need was great and its resources scarce, and the druids who had come to Outland to study a marsh were arming for war against the naga.
sources: quest 9765 reward text (These will do perfectly. Bring any more armaments you find. Our need is great and our resources are scarce.)
